room.garden-lantern-room.name: Garden lane with paper lanterns
room.garden-lantern-room.desc: Paper lanterns hang over a garden path lined with round bushes. At night, the lanterns glow softly along the path.
room.salt-mirror.name: Pink salt lake
room.salt-mirror.desc: A shell chair rests on pistachio flooring beneath strawberry-milk walls. Beyond an arched window, a pink lake mirrors a purple sky.
room.rose-celadon.name: Rose and celadon
room.rose-celadon.desc: A rose wall and pale ink-colored window frame rise behind a celadon teacup chair. The room feels like a little piece of craftwork.
room.peach-espresso.name: Peach espresso
room.peach-espresso.desc: An apricot ribbon sofa sits against cocoa wave-patterned walls. Small lakeside houses appear between purple curtains.
room.lime-lotus.name: Lime water-lily pond
room.lime-lotus.desc: Water lilies float on the pond beyond a round window. A lime lily-pad chair rests on a purple floor against pink arched walls.
room.amber-dream.name: Amber dream
room.amber-dream.desc: An amber shell chair holds a pale blue cushion. An arched window in the starry aubergine wall looks out on an oasis.
room.guava-canopy.name: Guava canopy
room.guava-canopy.desc: Large ribbon patterns flow like stems across guava-pink walls. A deep teal petal chair sits on the green floor.
room.vermillion-salt.name: Vermilion salt theater
room.vermillion-salt.desc: A wide window looks onto a purple sky and pink salt lake. A vermilion sofa sits against a row of apricot arches.
room.star-sail-room.name: Sailboat beneath the stars
room.star-sail-room.desc: A wide-open window frames a curved shore and a white sailboat. At night, the moon rises in the blue sky over the sea.
room.cobalt-silk.name: Cobalt silk boat
room.cobalt-silk.desc: A cobalt boat bed rests beneath a lemon paper lantern. Large circles decorate pink walls above a leaf-green floor.
room.coral-mangrove.name: Coral mangrove
room.coral-mangrove.desc: A leaf-green round sofa sits on a clear purple checked floor. Beyond the coral wall's window, flowers bloom on the water.
room.peach-poppy.name: Peach poppy
room.peach-poppy.desc: A crimson petal chair blooms beneath peach wave-patterned walls. Red flowers also cover the hills outside.
room.balloon-dawn-room.name: Apricot balloon dawn
room.balloon-dawn-room.desc: Small hot-air balloons rise in the dawn sky. Apricot walls, an aqua round sofa and a lilac carpet blend softly together.
room.orange-silk-dunes.name: Orange silk dunes
room.orange-silk-dunes.desc: A turquoise shell chair sits against orange wave-patterned walls. Palm trees line the oasis outside.
room.tea-stained-postcards.name: Tea-colored postcards
room.tea-stained-postcards.desc: Green hills appear beyond a tea-colored wooden window frame. An ink-colored suitcase bed rests beneath pale pink striped walls.
room.rose-rattan.name: Rest by the rose lake
room.rose-rattan.desc: A berry rattan chair sits on wood flooring that meets a pink lake. A flower lamp and green leaves add a fresh touch.
room.coral-door-room.name: Coral rock arch
room.coral-door-room.desc: A large rock on the left frames the mint-colored sea. A small stone arch stands in the distance.
room.coral-tide.name: Coral tide
room.coral-tide.desc: A coral boat bed rests on a turquoise floor. White clouds and the sea spread beyond a round window in the apricot wall.
room.bay-oat.name: Afternoon by the bay
room.bay-oat.desc: A little seaside room overlooks a wide turquoise bay. A round rug rests beside a boat-shaped seat on an aqua floor.
room.paprika-pool.name: Paprika pool
room.paprika-pool.desc: A deep teal sofa sits beneath a yellow ball-shaped lamp. Aqua checked tiles lie below paprika-colored walls.
room.terracotta-thread.name: Terracotta thread
room.terracotta-thread.desc: Cream floor cushions are stacked against terracotta brick walls. A palm oasis appears beyond turquoise curtains.
room.canal-corner-room.name: Apricot canal afternoon
room.canal-corner-room.desc: A winding canal runs between two nearby houses. A coral round sofa beneath the window is a quiet spot to watch the water.
room.desert-stars-room.name: White rocks under the stars
room.desert-stars-room.desc: Two arched windows overlook a white rock desert. A blue gem sofa sits against sandy walls, and the moon rises at night.
room.starlight-lake-room.name: Starlit lakeshore
room.starlight-lake-room.desc: A wide window beyond a deep teal sofa frames mountains and a lake. At night, stars appear and moonlight stretches across the water.
room.milky-river-room.name: Milky Way waterside
room.milky-river-room.desc: The Milky Way stretches diagonally across the window. Starlight spreads softly over a low, dark blue bay.
room.opal-apricot.name: Apricot opal
room.opal-apricot.desc: An opal gem sofa rests against apricot walls. Ice floats on a lake beneath snowy mountains outside.
room.moss-post-office.name: Moss-green post office
room.moss-post-office.desc: A moss-colored suitcase bed sits against brick-pink walls, with green hills outside. The room feels like a postcard gathered on a trip.
room.woven-pomegranate.name: Woven pomegranate
room.woven-pomegranate.desc: A pomegranate rattan chair sits against apricot leaf-patterned walls. A small village among fields appears through an arched window.
room.dunes-rattan.name: Rest by the dunes
room.dunes-rattan.desc: A pink rattan chair and small salt lamp face warm-colored dunes. At night, a round moon rises above the sand.
room.lemon-cobalt.name: Lemon and cobalt
room.lemon-cobalt.desc: Butter-colored striped walls frame a view of the calm sea. A tomato-red mushroom lamp stands beside a deep blue sofa.
room.blueberry-meringue.name: Blueberry meringue box
room.blueberry-meringue.desc: A deep blueberry teacup chair sits against pale butter checked walls. A round window looks onto a lake and mountains.
room.lotus-postcard.name: Water-lily postcard
room.lotus-postcard.desc: A Korean lattice window overlooks a lakeside flower garden. A purple lily-pad chair sits against butter-colored arches.
room.citron-aubergine.name: Citron and aubergine
room.citron-aubergine.desc: An aubergine lily-pad chair stands against lemon-yellow arched walls. Water lilies fill the pond beyond the window.
room.saffron-quilt.name: Saffron patchwork
room.saffron-quilt.desc: Saffron walls warm a purple and turquoise patchwork sofa. A palm oasis spreads beyond a Korean lattice window.
room.honey-reed-room.name: Honey-colored reeds at dusk
room.honey-reed-room.desc: Two arched windows overlook golden reeds and green waterways. At night, little lights twinkle among the reeds.
room.dunes-sage.name: A room by the dunes
room.dunes-sage.desc: A pale sage shell chair sits in a sandy room. A soft rug and woven lamp echo the quiet of the dunes.
room.tangerine-olive.name: Tangerine olive
room.tangerine-olive.desc: A record player sits beside a tangerine beanbag in a geometric-patterned room. Sunflowers fill the view outside.
room.saffron-turquoise.name: Saffron and turquoise
room.saffron-turquoise.desc: An aubergine gem sofa sits on turquoise checked flooring against golden walls. A round window frames an oasis surrounded by palms.
room.butter-cloud.name: Butter cloud house
room.butter-cloud.desc: A blue cloud sofa nestles against butter-colored walls. A sea of clouds spreads beyond a sky-blue window frame.
room.orange-sherbet-bow.name: Orange sherbet ribbon
room.orange-sherbet-bow.desc: A small record player sits beside a large orange ribbon sofa. Butter-colored walls and a lilac floor feel fresh.
room.moonlit-path-room.name: Crescent forest arch
room.moonlit-path-room.desc: A large arched window behind an orchid-colored petal chair frames tall trees and a winding forest path. A crescent moon rises at night.
room.pistachio-rose.name: Pistachio and rose
room.pistachio-rose.desc: A pink petal chair and cherry tulip lamp sit against pale green and rose walls. Flowering meadows and a lake lie outside.
room.meadow-sage.name: A room facing the meadow
room.meadow-sage.desc: A teacup chair in a green room faces a flower garden. A tulip lamp and petal rug make a little garden of their own.
room.tourmaline-candy.name: Tourmaline candy
room.tourmaline-candy.desc: Pale lemon walls and a watermelon ribbon sofa feel like a treasured candy box. Snowy mountains and floating ice appear outside.
room.pomegranate-electric.name: Pomegranate and electric blue
room.pomegranate-electric.desc: A pomegranate ribbon sofa stands against butter-colored walls above a cool cobalt floor. A rosy canyon winds beyond the arched window.
room.meadow-carousel.name: Meadow carousel
room.meadow-carousel.desc: Yellow striped walls, a blue checked floor and a pink petal chair feel cheerful. A bright sunflower field spreads beyond the window.
room.willow-waterway-room.name: Willow waterway
room.willow-waterway-room.desc: Drooping willows and a quiet waterway appear beyond plum window frames. A patchwork sofa offers a quiet place to rest.
room.muhly-wind-room.name: Pink muhly in the wind
room.muhly-wind-room.desc: Soft, cottony pink grass fills the view below the window. A single path leads through it toward distant mountains.
room.melon-hibiscus.name: Melon hibiscus
room.melon-hibiscus.desc: The room is bright as fruit candy. A pink teacup chair sits on turquoise tiles against melon-colored walls.
room.grass-ridge-room.name: Green grass ridge
room.grass-ridge-room.desc: A cream-colored path crosses a sloping green hill. A round tangerine sofa by the window offers a place to watch the hills.
room.silver-reed-room.name: Reed-lined river bend
room.silver-reed-room.desc: A winding waterway and open sky appear among silver reeds by the window. A small camping lantern sits beside the sofa.
room.mint-vinyl.name: Mint vinyl
room.mint-vinyl.desc: A purple sofa and coral globe lamp sit against mint walls. City lights come on one by one outside at night.
room.harbor-lantern-room.name: Harbor with a lighthouse
room.harbor-lantern-room.desc: A wide window frames lit houses, a lighthouse and a crescent moon. Golden light ripples on the blue sea.
room.vermilion-celadon.name: Vermilion celadon workshop
room.vermilion-celadon.desc: A vermilion suitcase bed unfolds against pale celadon walls. Water lilies float in circles on the pond outside.
room.jade-cranberry.name: Jade and cranberry
room.jade-cranberry.desc: A round pearl lamp stands beside a bright red ribbon sofa. A round window in the deep jade wall overlooks snowy mountains.
room.forest-velvet.name: Forest velvet
room.forest-velvet.desc: A pink round sofa sits beneath a brass lamp against dark green leafy walls. A forest path lies beyond the curtains, with a crescent moon at night.
room.bay-rattan.name: Rattan by the water
room.bay-rattan.desc: A rattan chair and small lantern sit on aqua wood flooring by the turquoise sea. Large leaves stretch out beside a round rug.
room.jade-island.name: Afternoon on a jade island
room.jade-island.desc: Purple curtains and a pink rattan chair brighten jade walls. A rocky shore with tide pools lies outside.
room.apricot-glass.name: Apricot glass
room.apricot-glass.desc: A translucent pale purple sofa sits on an apricot floor beneath aqua tiled walls. Small fish swim in the tank beside it.
room.grotto-light-room.name: Light in the grotto
room.grotto-light-room.desc: Mint-colored water shines inside a purple cave beyond the window. Its soft glow lingers into the night.
room.tomato-swimming.name: Tomato pool
room.tomato-swimming.desc: A vivid tomato-red sofa sits against blue wave-patterned walls. A yellow rug rests on the mint checked floor.
room.orchid-ink.name: Inky orchid garden
room.orchid-ink.desc: A lake and yellow flower garden fill the window. An orchid-pink lily-pad chair rests against deep teal walls.
room.estuary-dawn-room.name: Estuary at dawn
room.estuary-dawn-room.desc: Mirror-like water spreads beyond a long sandbar. In this quiet room, the water changes color more slowly than the sky.
room.cherry-soda.name: Cherry soda
room.cherry-soda.desc: Aqua checked walls frame a cherry blossom path outside. A red lamp hangs over a cherry sofa, and the floor is milky white tile.
room.canyon-ballet.name: Canyon ballet
room.canyon-ballet.desc: A river flows through red canyons beneath a pink sky. A dark cherry ribbon sofa sits against pale teal walls.
room.ink-marigold.name: Ink and marigold
room.ink-marigold.desc: A palm oasis appears through a half-open Korean lattice window. A patchwork sofa rests on brick-colored flooring against deep navy walls.
room.poolside-cherry.name: Poolside cherry
room.poolside-cherry.desc: A cherry bathtub sofa and cloud rug sit on a pale pink checked floor. Blue striped walls and a small fish tank add a cool touch.
room.rosewood-tide.name: Rosewood tide
room.rosewood-tide.desc: A lilac gem sofa sits on rose-colored wood flooring. A wide window in deep aqua walls overlooks a lake of water lilies.
room.quiet-aurora.name: Quiet aurora
room.quiet-aurora.desc: A lilac cloud sofa and apricot star lamp sit against deep teal walls. A ringed planet floats beyond the round window.
room.ribbon-snow-room.name: Ribbons of light above the snow
room.ribbon-snow-room.desc: Auroras flow over snowy hills beyond two arched windows. Mint, lilac and rose ribbons of light sweep across the sky.
room.snow-oat.name: A room facing the snowfield
room.snow-oat.desc: A peach cloud bed rests in a blue room overlooking snowy fields. A soft rug, books and a small lantern make a warm corner.
room.moon-ground-room.name: Lunar landscape
room.moon-ground-room.desc: A round crater lies just outside the window, with a blue Earth in the distant sky. A pink shell chair and small fish tank sit inside.
room.snow-reed-room.name: Snowy reed lake
room.snow-reed-room.desc: An unfrozen lake appears among snow-covered reeds. Berry cushions add warmth.
room.north-blue-room.name: Quiet north
room.north-blue-room.desc: An open sky stretches above snowy hills and a few small firs. A lantern and bookcase sit beside a pink cloud sofa.
room.lantern-quay-room.name: Quay waiting for lanterns
room.lantern-quay-room.desc: A low wooden pier stretches out over broad water. Three small lanterns line the pier.
room.alpine-starlight-room.name: Moonlit lake below alpine peaks
room.alpine-starlight-room.desc: A large arched window frames snowy peaks and a calm lake. A rose-colored shell chair sits by the window.
room.pink-glacier.name: A nap by the pink glacier
room.pink-glacier.desc: A glacier tinted rose and lilac spreads beyond the window. A deep pink shell chair against sky-blue walls makes a cozy nap spot.
room.luminous-bay-room.name: Luminous coast
room.luminous-bay-room.desc: A curving beach fills the window below the distant horizon. A soft glow traces where turquoise waves meet wet sand.
room.blue-hour-harbor.name: Blue hour harbor
room.blue-hour-harbor.desc: Clouds and distant islands appear through a round window. A peach suitcase bed and small lantern sit against deep blue walls.
room.indigo-paper.name: Indigo paper room
room.indigo-paper.desc: Rice fields and a village appear through a half-open paper lattice window. An apricot patchwork sofa rests against indigo walls.
room.moon-milk.name: Moon milk
room.moon-milk.desc: A round window in blue-gray walls frames the moon above the clouds. An eggshell sofa and small fish tank sit side by side below.
room.indigo-coral-fold.name: Indigo coral patchwork
room.indigo-coral-fold.desc: A patchwork sofa holds a coral quilt. Indigo arched walls and a clear turquoise floor feel cool, and a palm oasis spreads beyond the window.
room.snowberry-cabin.name: Snowberry cabin
room.snowberry-cabin.desc: A warm lantern stands beside layered floor cushions topped with a berry cushion. Beyond a curtained window in glacier-colored walls lie snowy mountains.
room.rain-blueberry.name: Blueberry rain
room.rain-blueberry.desc: A mint bathtub sofa sits against blue-violet tiled walls. A little sailboat floats on the sea beyond the open arched window.
room.ultramarine-melon.name: Ultramarine melon
room.ultramarine-melon.desc: A melon lily-pad chair sits on a pink stone floor. An arched window in deep blue walls overlooks a flowering lakeshore.
room.planet-charcoal.name: A chair by the station
room.planet-charcoal.desc: A large planet hangs above a blue-gray deck. A moon lamp and record player sit beside a charcoal rattan chair.
room.rose-ink-mirage.name: Rose and ink mirage
room.rose-ink-mirage.desc: A rose ribbon sofa sits against deep inky purple walls. A blue mirage shimmers among pink rocks beyond an arched window.
room.three-planets-room.name: Sky with three planets
room.three-planets-room.desc: A mint planet, a peach ringed planet and a large striped planet fill the arched window. A tangerine round sofa below offers a spot to look up.
room.lilac-citrus.name: Lilac and tangerine
room.lilac-citrus.desc: A tangerine round sofa sits between lilac walls and a grass-green floor. A flower-filled meadow spreads beyond the arched window.
room.mist-valley-room.name: Misty valley
room.mist-valley-room.desc: Thin layers of purple mist rest in the valley beyond an arched window. A peach cloud sofa sits by the window.
room.violet-fog.name: Violet mist
room.violet-fog.desc: A pale cloud bed and plum arched lamp sit beneath lavender walls. At night, a crescent moon rises above the fir forest outside.
room.cloud-pass-room.name: Cloud mountain pass
room.cloud-pass-room.desc: Clouds drift among peaks beyond a wide window. A paper star lamp hangs above it, with a blue cloud sofa below.
room.blue-wisteria.name: Blue wisteria letter
room.blue-wisteria.desc: An apricot suitcase bed rests beneath a blue paper lantern. Two windows in a purple arched wall look out on a lakeshore with blue flowers.
room.amethyst-saffron.name: Amethyst and saffron
room.amethyst-saffron.desc: A saffron tulip lamp and blue gem sofa stand against an amethyst wave-patterned wall. A clear oasis rests among the dunes outside.
room.plum-orchard.name: Plum orchard
room.plum-orchard.desc: Leaf patterns cover plum walls, with a lemon cushion on the pink floor. A path winds among green hills outside.
room.strawberry-parlor.name: Strawberry parlor
room.strawberry-parlor.desc: A strawberry teacup chair sits on a sky-blue floor. A curtained window in pale pink checked walls overlooks a path of flowering trees.
room.licorice-confetti.name: Licorice confetti
room.licorice-confetti.desc: A yellow gem sofa sits against inky purple walls with large circles. A desert lies beyond the pink curtains, and the floor is pale mint.
room.black-cherry-pistachio.name: Black cherry pistachio
room.black-cherry-pistachio.desc: A strawberry ribbon sofa pairs with pistachio flooring and dark cherry walls. At night, the waterside village lights up beyond two arched windows.
room.raspberry-lime.name: Raspberry lime club
room.raspberry-lime.desc: A deep purple flower lamp stands beside a lime round sofa. Raspberry arched walls and mint checked flooring feel fresh.
room.raspberry-denim.name: Raspberry denim
room.raspberry-denim.desc: City buildings appear between blue curtains. A butter-colored sofa brightens raspberry walls and a denim-blue floor.
room.sugar-dunes.name: Sugar dunes
room.sugar-dunes.desc: A blue shell chair opens wide on a honey-colored floor. Beyond an arched window in pink walls lies an oasis surrounded by palms.
